parsed.name: QICK量子控制软件组件
parsed.description: 这是一个非物理的软件组件，用于实验控制程序中表示与QICK量子控制平台相关的仪器对象。根据现有证据，它主要提供 tProc 时钟周期与秒之间的时间换算，以及读取设备标识信息，适合在量子控制实验的软件流程中做时序参数处理与基本识别。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software component representing an instrument object associated with the QICK quantum control platform in experiment-control software. Based on the available evidence, it mainly provides time conversion between tProc clock cycles and seconds, plus retrieval of identification information, for timing parameter handling and basic device identification in quantum-control workflows.

actions.description: 将 tProc 时钟周期数转换为秒
actions.description_en: Convert the number of tProc clock cycles to seconds.

actions.description: 将秒转换为 tProc 时钟周期数
actions.description_en: Convert seconds to the number of tProc clock cycles.
